extDescription.message: Paste URLs separated by newlines or commas and open them all at once in new tabs.

extLongDescription.message:
[Overview]
This Chrome extension opens many URLs at once. Paste text that contains URLs separated by newlines or commas, then run the batch to create one tab per URL.

[Highlights]
- Minimal interface with a single textbox and run button
- Accepts both newline and comma delimiters
- Skips blank lines and invalid inputs automatically
- Shows instant feedback inside the popup for success or errors

[How to use]
1. Click the extension icon in the browser toolbar
2. Paste one or more URLs, either line-by-line or comma separated
3. Press the “Open URLs” button and each URL opens in a new tab

[Limitations]
- Subject to Chrome's tab limits and each site’s own restrictions
- Only http/https URLs are opened
- Does not provide background tab management or scheduling
